method: Isolated Play-mode PhysicsScene2D; fixture WorldRotator.IsRotating is set explicitly, then production PlayerController.BeginPhysicsStep -> local Simulate -> CompletePhysicsStep. No main-scene step, PlayerLoop frame, or fixture Start runs.

results.name: Rotation pauses automatic X while gravity continues / anti-push on
results.detail: Only automatic horizontal contribution is held. Dynamic-body free fall continues; final velocity=(0.00, -1.18)

results.name: Rotation pauses automatic X while gravity continues / anti-push off
results.detail: Only automatic horizontal contribution is held. Dynamic-body free fall continues; final velocity=(0.00, -1.18)

results.name: A single false IsRotating sample does not resume input
results.detail: true -> false for one 10 ms step -> true must not introduce an automatic X pulse.

results.name: Continuous false resumes at 0.15 seconds
results.detail: No contribution during the first 0.14 s of continuous false; the next step reaches 0.15 s and restores configured autoMoveSpeed.

results.name: A new true sample resets the quiet-time countdown
results.detail: Two interrupted 0.10 s false periods cannot be added together; only the uninterrupted last 0.15 s resumes input.

results.name: Turning the feature off resumes immediately / anti-push on
results.detail: Disabling the option restores legacy automatic X on the next physics step even while IsRotating remains true.

results.name: Turning the feature off resumes immediately / anti-push off
results.detail: Disabling the option restores legacy automatic X on the next physics step even while IsRotating remains true.

results.name: Paused automatic input still removes a real wall impulse and repairs overlap
results.detail: The kinematic wall creates a real solver impulse while automatic input is paused. The player removes its injected velocity, and CrushGuard still performs bounded position repair.
